build_deci_lm_model: build a DeciLMForCausalLM model from a LlamaConfig for inference with HuggingFace weights
create_decoder_layer: create a DeciLMDecoderLayer with block-level attention and FFN no-op configuration
load_model_weights: load stacked QKV and gate-up projection weights from HuggingFace checkpoint into DeciLMForCausalLM
run_model_forward: run a forward pass on DeciLMForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward batch for causal LM generation
compute_intermediate_size: compute FFN intermediate size from ffn_mult and hidden embedding dimension aligned to 256
